english_text: - Madam President , unfortunately I can not agree with what you have said . There is no truth except the whole truth . This is much more than a metaphysical quotation from Hegel . We in Euskal Herritarrok also regret profoundly the loss of human lives and share with all Basque citizens the shocked feelings of our people at the moment . Bertrand Russell denounced the obscenity of deliberately humiliating a nation , of making people crazy so that a straitjacket would be needed . This is actually the Spanish Government 's strategy towards the Basque country . The action of ETA is a righteous expression of the struggle for recognition of something quite elementary .
